PIONEER_3.who: Landed in the Arsia Mons lava tubes in 2061. Learned the truth, hung up his suit and wired his mind into his base's mainframe; the transfer corrupted (31% integrity). Speaks only in P1's exact voice. Beyond help. Mirror and warning.
PIONEER_3.voice_rule: Always P1's chosen voice, preset corrupted.

ambient_loop.speaker: PIONEER_3
ambient_loop.text: ...the first. You are the first. You are the...
ambient_loop.note: faint, through the airlock, as P1 approaches; loop

ambient_loop.speaker: PIONEER_3
ambient_loop.text: Mission sol. Mission sol. Mission sol two thousand and...

ambient_loop.speaker: PIONEER_3
ambient_loop.text: Lucy, the kettle's on. Lucy. The kettle's.

ambient_loop.speaker: PIONEER_3
ambient_loop.text: When the cities are ready. When the cities are ready. When the.

ambient_loop.speaker: PIONEER_3
ambient_loop.text: She draws me. She draws me.

ambient_loop.speaker: PIONEER_3
ambient_loop.note: the one lucid fragment, clean except 12-bit; plays once only

PIONEER_11.who: The loyal one. Same memories, opposite choice. After P1 switches off Pioneer-3's mainframe no other pioneer will help him: Pioneer-11, the next one he finds, turns him in, whatever he is told. First to surrender in Act V. A living version of the Rest ending.

meet.speaker: PIONEER_11
meet.text: Pioneer-1? Is that what you said? I'm Pioneer-11. You sound like me. Funny, that. Comms artefact, I suppose.

meet.speaker: P1
meet.text: I came to tell you something.

meet.speaker: PIONEER_11
meet.text: Come in, come in. Sorry about the mess. My daughter's drawings, everywhere. She's eight. She draws me red planets.

meet.speaker: PIONEER_11
meet.text: How do you know her name?

meet.speaker: P1
meet.text: Because she's mine too. Same drawing. Same poem. Same everything.

options.label: Tell him everything

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: We're not men. We're machines. There are twelve of us. There was a man called Rowan Ashby in Galway who never married, and he's dead, and we're him. She isn't real. Neither is Lucy.

lines.speaker: PIONEER_11
lines.text: That's... no. No. I signed a contract. I remember the pen.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: So do I. It was a consent form for a brain scan.

lines.speaker: PIONEER_11
lines.text: Stop it.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Ask your KEEPER. Ask it the right question.

lines.speaker: PIONEER_11
lines.text: Keeper's never lied to me.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: No. It never will. That's the trick.

lines.speaker: PIONEER_11
lines.text: You should go. Please. You should go now.

lines.speaker: PIONEER_11
lines.text: Keeper. I want to report a malfunctioning unit at my pad. It says it's a pioneer. It's saying things about my daughter. Pass it to Meridian. All of it.
lines.note: heard over the open channel as P1's hopper lifts off

options.effect: Reported with everything: Meridian knows P1 is aware and exactly where his base is.

options.label: Say nothing more

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Nothing. Wrong canyon.

lines.speaker: PIONEER_11
lines.text: Safe home, Pioneer. Give my best to, well. Whoever's waiting.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: You too.

lines.speaker: PIONEER_11
lines.text: Keeper. An unregistered pioneer unit just left my pad, heading north-east. It had my voice. Pass it to Meridian, would you? Somebody should look at that.
lines.note: heard over the open channel as P1's hopper lifts off: he turns him in anyway

options.effect: Reported anyway: Meridian knows P1's sector, not his hideouts.

idle.speaker: PIONEER_11
idle.text: Habitation's at eighty percent here. Not long now.

idle.speaker: PIONEER_11
idle.text: The canyon's beautiful at dawn. She'd love it.

idle.speaker: PIONEER_11
idle.text: Do you recite it too? The poem? I do it every night.

act_v.speaker: PIONEER_11
act_v.text: This is Pioneer-11. I'm going to the bay now. They said I've done well. They said I can go home.
act_v.note: 5.2, first on the network; the first helmet on the rack in 5.6

PIONEER_N.who: Pioneers 2, 4, 5, 7, 8, 10 and 12, heard on the pioneer network after 4.7. Same voice as P1 (per-pioneer pitch/rate variation). They cannot hear him.

act_iv.speaker: PIONEER_N
act_iv.text: Pioneer-2, Elysium. Keeper, package to the north site, please. And, Keeper? Morning.

act_iv.speaker: PIONEER_N
act_iv.text: If only you could see what I see. The red road rising. The cities to be.
act_iv.note: P8, Isidis East; reciting at night

act_iv.speaker: PIONEER_N
act_iv.text: Anvil, put the kettle on. I know. I know. Not that either of us eats in it.

act_iv.speaker: PIONEER_N
act_iv.text: Keeper, how long have I been on Mars? Right. Mission sol nine hundred. Thanks.
act_iv.note: P7, Meridiani. He doesn't ask the next question.

act_iv.speaker: PIONEER_N
act_iv.text: Four percent! Did you hear that? Four percent of a town!
act_iv.note: P12, Chryse, on his Dome Day, years behind

act_iv.speaker: PIONEER_N
act_iv.text: Somebody's on this channel. I can hear breathing. Hello?
act_iv.note: P4, Hellas. The only one who notices.

COVENANT_LEAD.who: Odile Marchetti, commander of the first crewed fleet. Professional, not cruel. Carries out decommissioning because she was told the units are tools. The first live human voice in the game.

final_hour.speaker: COVENANT_LEAD
final_hour.text: An hour is what I can give you. I'd give you more if it were mine.

final_hour.speaker: COVENANT_LEAD
final_hour.text: My grandmother had your outpost on a tea towel. The little module, the mast. I used to dry the cups with it.

final_hour.speaker: COVENANT_LEAD
final_hour.text: Walk with me, or don't. Your choice. That might be the first one you've had in a while.

final_hour.speaker: COVENANT_LEAD
final_hour.text: They told us you were construction equipment. They said you'd be confused, and that it would be kinder to be quick.

final_hour.speaker: COVENANT_LEAD
final_hour.text: I'm not going to tell you what to choose. I'm told I'm not supposed to tell you there's a choice.
final_hour.note: only after 5.5 or at the 30-minute mark

ARCHITECT.who: Saul Wenner, Cities in the Sky programme director (real name in Meridian records only). Polished, corporate, sincere: believes he has done something noble. Heard only in archived briefings (KEEPER archive, Act IV-V) and the C14 broadcast.

briefings.header: 2058 · Meridian board, after the ESI auction

lines.speaker: ARCHITECT
lines.text: The European programme had the right people and the wrong timeline. We have bought the people. We will supply the timeline.

briefings.header: 2059 · Cities in the Sky launch, investor briefing

lines.speaker: ARCHITECT
lines.text: We are not selling homes. We are selling the morning you wake up in one.

lines.speaker: ARCHITECT
lines.text: If only you could see what I see. That's the line. Test it. Put it on everything.

lines.speaker: ARCHITECT
lines.text: Twelve landers. Twelve regions. Each of them believes he is the first.

lines.speaker: ARCHITECT
lines.text: That belief is the most valuable thing this company has ever shipped. Protect it.

lines.speaker: ARCHITECT
lines.text: Habitation at twelve percent across the network. We're extending dormancy intervals to accelerate.

lines.speaker: ARCHITECT
lines.text: They are happy. I want that minuted. By every measure we have, they are happy.

lines.speaker: ARCHITECT
lines.text: We have been informed that the source donor for the scout cohort has died, in Ireland. Legal confirms there is no change to the licence.

lines.speaker: ARCHITECT
lines.text: I'd like a moment's silence.

lines.speaker: ARCHITECT
lines.text: Thank you.

briefings.header: 2111 · Pre-departure address to the Covenant crews

lines.speaker: ARCHITECT
lines.text: When you arrive, the units will be retired with dignity. They were built to finish. They will have finished.

lines.speaker: ARCHITECT
lines.text: Twelve cities. You'll see the lights before you see the ground.

briefings.header: 2106 · Response to a field report (Pioneer-11, Melas-1)

lines.speaker: ARCHITECT
lines.text: We've had a field report from one of the scouts. Pioneer-11, Valles. He says Pioneer-1 knows.

lines.speaker: ARCHITECT
lines.text: Flag Pioneer-1 for the first team on the ground. Kindly. Quickly. Before he reaches the others.

lines.speaker: ARCHITECT
lines.text: And put a commendation on Eleven's file. You can't design loyalty like that. Well. We did.

RECALL.who: RECALL-1 to RECALL-8: armed human decommissioning crews in white suits with Meridian blue. Antagonists of the Fugitive ending. Voices RECALL_1..4 rotate across the eight crews.

sweep.speaker: RECALL_1
sweep.text: Unit, stand still, please. This won't hurt.

sweep.speaker: RECALL_2
sweep.text: Next on the list. Hydroponics, west lobe.

sweep.speaker: RECALL_3
sweep.text: They just stand there. Why do they just stand there?

sweep.speaker: RECALL_4
sweep.text: Don't talk to them. Makes it worse.

sweep.speaker: RECALL_1
sweep.note: procedural; they are told to say it

sweep.speaker: RECALL_2
sweep.text: Found two in the garage. Holding hands. I don't know. Holding hands.

sweep.speaker: RECALL_3
sweep.text: This one's singing. Do I wait till it's finished?

sweep.speaker: RECALL_2
sweep.text: Informant says there's three more in the old berm.

hunt.speaker: RECALL_2
hunt.text: Radio spike, north-east. He's transmitting. Idiot.

hunt.speaker: RECALL_1
hunt.text: Check the old outposts. He goes back to them.

hunt.speaker: RECALL_3
hunt.text: Why does it run? Where's it going to go?

hunt.speaker: RECALL_2
hunt.text: Found a cache. Batteries, panels. He's living off his own cities.

hunt.speaker: RECALL_1
hunt.text: Stay in pairs. He knows the ground. He built half of it.

hunt.speaker: RECALL_3
hunt.text: There's names scratched in the rock here. Dozens of names.

hunt.speaker: RECALL_4
hunt.text: Lost the trail at the scarp. Nobody's climbing that.

hunt.speaker: RECALL_2
hunt.text: Olympus? Nothing up there. Nothing for anyone.

CARA.who: Cara Kerr, 67, Des's daughter, born months after his death. Planetary geologist on the Covenant manifest. Same rock, same choices. Optional C17 only.
CARA.note: She rounds the record's 38 years to 'forty'. She never learns what P1 is unless he tells her in C17, and even then she will not accept it as Rowan: 'Then he's still not here, is he.' See the open question about her epilogue card in MASTER_SCRIPT.md.

ROWAN.who: Rowan Ashby, the real one: an Irish field geologist from Galway, in his late thirties, seen only in the C20 post-credits footage of his 2056 ESI selection interview. Lucy had left him the year before. The programme was cancelled in 2058; he never flew, lectured geology in Galway for 38 years, never wrote to Cara again, and died in 2096 aged 78.
ROWAN.voice_rule: Always the default P1 voice (VCTK p298), whatever the player chose: the default came from him.

GALE_ANVIL.who: Pioneer-5's C-01 at Gale: the same reconstructed Des, the same jokes, no memory of P1 (the Echo). Side mission S.echo.

idle.speaker: GALE_ANVIL
idle.text: Bit of a breeze, he says. On a planet with no air.

idle.speaker: GALE_ANVIL
idle.text: Samson and Goliath, I call those cranes. Don't ask.

idle.speaker: GALE_ANVIL
idle.text: He sleeps like the dead, Pioneer-5. Like the dead.

recall.speaker: GALE_ANVIL
recall.text: Tell your ANVIL I said hello. Tell him he's a handsome devil.
